meta.title: Pricing — Engflex
meta.description: Engflex is free to start: 18 lessons from A1 to C2 with four skills each. Plus is 199,000₫ a month for the 15 everyday roleplays and feedback after each conversation.

hero.title: Start free.
hero.body: The lesson path is free at every level, A1 to C2. Plus adds the part you cannot do on your own: talking with a partner who answers.

free.name: Free
free.feature1: 18 lessons from A1 to C2, three at every level
free.feature2: All four steps in every lesson: read it, hear it, write it, say it
free.feature3: 108 questions with an explanation for each answer

plus.name: Plus
plus.feature2: All 15 everyday roleplays, seven topics, A1 to B1
plus.feature3: A partner who stays in character

included.title: The same either way.
included.body: The lesson path is the same whether you pay or not.
included.item1Body: read it, hear it, write it, say it

closing.title: Start where you are.
closing.body: Free at every level, from A1 to C2.
